programs.name: Warm Up Run - Sample Workout
programs.overview:
Head out for an easy jog at a moderate pace. The effort should feel like a 4/10 - in other words, you should be able to breathe through your nose and hold a conversation.
-
Today's workout can be performed using your Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE) - a scale used to identify the intensity of your exercise based on how hard you feel (or perceive) your effort to be. The RPE scale runs from 0 to 10, with zero being literally nothing and 10 being the hardest you could possibly exert yourself.
-
If you have some running experience your threshold pace will be a little slower than your 5k pace or about the same as your 10k pace.
-
When you're done, if you've connected your device to TrainingPeaks, your ride data will upload automatically to your account for you to review!
-
If you haven't connected your device yet, get started here: https://www.trainingpeaks.com/upload/

programs.name: RG SPIKE — SAFE TO DELETE strength
Tempo Intervals - Sample Worko
programs.overview:
Jog easy for 10 minutes
-
Then perform three, 6 minute intervals at 80% of your threshold heart rate, followed by 3 minutes easy walk/run at 60% of your threshold heart rate in between.
-
Jog easy for 10 minutes after to cool down.

Easy Run - Sample Workout
programs.overview:
Run at an easy pace, easy enough to hold a conversation at an RPE of 5/10.

Don't push the pace - other workouts will push you! Easy running is the foundation of all running training and going hard on your easy days only increases the chance you'll get injured.
